name: Acute Arterial Hypoxemia
missingDataBehavior: If SpO2 is missing or non-numeric, flags INSUFFICIENT_DATA and suppresses rule evaluation.
dataQualityCheck: Evaluates PPG perfusion index (PI > 0.5%) and correlates with respiratory rate elevation to exclude probe disconnect.
rationale: Arterial oxygen desaturation indicates compromised cabin/suit partial O2 pressure, breathing gas contamination, or pulmonary shunt.
cautiousNextStep: Check suit umbilical seals, switch to emergency 100% O2 purge loop, remain calm to reduce oxygen consumption.
escalationGuidance: Notify Flight Surgeon and EVA buddy immediately; abort spacewalk if SpO2 fails to recover within 60 seconds.
scientificSource: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 §6.3; FAA Office of Commercial Space Transportation Physiological Guidelines.

name: Sustained Resting Tachycardia
missingDataBehavior: If HR is null, flags 'Sensor Disconnected / Reposition Lead-II Electrode'.
dataQualityCheck: Inspects Lead-II R-R interval consistency to differentiate true sinus tachycardia from muscle EMG motion artifact.
rationale: Non-exertional tachycardia in microgravity may signify hypovolemia, autonomic dysfunction, acute infection, or compensatory cardiac drift.
cautiousNextStep: Sit upright or strap into sleep station, hydrate with 500 mL electrolyte solution, practice paced slow breathing.
escalationGuidance: Alert Crew Medical Officer if resting heart rate remains > 115 bpm after 10 minutes of complete physical rest.

name: Cabin Atmospheric Hypercapnia
missingDataBehavior: Defaults cabin pressure to 760 mmHg with an explicit baseline assumption note.
dataQualityCheck: Cross-verifies primary and redundant non-dispersive infrared (NDIR) carbon dioxide sensors.
rationale: Elevated CO2 in microgravity induces cerebral vasodilation, headaches, spatial disorientation, and visual disturbances.
cautiousNextStep: Increase cabin ventilation fans in sleeping quarters, verify Carbon Dioxide Removal Assembly (CDRA) scrubber bed cycle.
escalationGuidance: Notify Mission Control Flight Directors to reconfigure environmental life-support scrubbers.

name: High-Flux Ionizing Radiation Event
missingDataBehavior: Flags sensor blackout, alerts crew to inspect physical dosimeters.
dataQualityCheck: Correlates silicon detector rates with external SPE magnetometer alert channels.
rationale: Solar Particle Events generate massive fluxes of energetic protons (> 100 MeV), risking acute radiation sickness and hematopoietic suppression.
cautiousNextStep: Relocate crew to central storm shelter (polyethylene shielded core / water-wall compartments).
escalationGuidance: Coordinate with Space Radiation Analysis Group (SRAG) at Johnson Space Center for solar flare trajectory updates.

name: SANS Cephalad Fluid Redistribution & Optic Sheath Expansion
condition: ONSD > 5.80 mm OR acute dilation > 0.5 mm above pre-flight baseline
missingDataBehavior: Classified as NOT_MEASURED; no speculative alert generated.
dataQualityCheck: Requires verification that ultrasound probe is perpendicular to optic nerve axis 3 mm behind retina.
rationale: Cephalad venous engorgement increases retrobulbar subarachnoid pressure, predisposing to papilledema and hyperopic visual shift.
cautiousNextStep: Initiate 30–60 minute session of Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) at -25 mmHg; maintain dietary sodium restriction < 2,000 mg/day.
escalationGuidance: Transmit raw OCT and ultrasound images to ground Flight Surgeon telemedicine queue for expert review.
scientificSource: NASA Human Research Program SANS Evidence Report; Lee et al. (2020).

name: Paroxysmal Ventricular Tachyarrhythmia
condition: heart_rate > 150 bpm AND sudden onset (delta HR > 50 bpm within 3s) AND workload == 0
missingDataBehavior: Requires at least 3 consecutive anomalous QRS complexes before critical trigger.
dataQualityCheck: Analyzes Lead-II baseline noise; confirms absence of preceding exertional work telemetry.
rationale: Ventricular tachycardia or rapid conduction disturbance severely diminishes cardiac output and stroke volume.
cautiousNextStep: Direct astronaut to assume safe reclined posture, attach continuous 12-lead monitoring, ready Automated External Defibrillator (AED).
escalationGuidance: Immediate urgent alert to Crew Medical Officer and emergency telemetry priority packet to ground flight surgeons.
scientificSource: PhysioNet MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database (#208); NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 §4.1.

name: Sensor & Telemetry Data Quality Verification
acceptedUnits: ISO / MET timestamp, valid numeric values
condition: Detects missing required columns, non-numeric values, out-of-order timestamps, duplicate timestamps, or impossible physical readings (e.g. SpO2 > 100% or < 40%, HR < 20 or > 260)
missingDataBehavior: Marks data status as 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA_FOR_INTERPRETATION' and halts clinical scoring.
rationale: Clinical decision algorithms must not generate confident diagnostic conclusions from corrupt, truncated, or noisy telemetry.
cautiousNextStep: Inspect sensor placement, verify electrode adhesion, re-seat telemetry cable connectors, reload CSV fixture.
escalationGuidance: If sensor malfunction persists, switch to secondary redundant biomedical sensor harness.
scientificSource: Good Machine Learning Practice (GMLP) & FDA Guidance for Clinical Decision Support Software.
